noNpm: npm not found, so the WebUI can't be built
noNode: Node.js/npm not found, so the WebUI can't be built

log.patchSaved: Saved the local changes as a patch: {target}
log.worktreeCleanup: Couldn't clean up the temporary Git worktree: {source}

archiveLayout: The source archive has an unexpected layout
downloadFailed: Source download failed. Check the network connection.
archiveTooLarge: The source archive is too large, so the download was cancelled

step.rollback: Deployment failed. Restoring the previous version
step.configCheck: Checking the settings against the new version
step.verify: Checking the current commit and the remote tracking branch

noPages: The WebUI build produced no pages
configIncompatible: The new version can't load the settings file {value}, so the restart was cancelled. See the update log.
recoveryFailed: {error}; automatic recovery failed. Check Git and the dependencies by hand. The backup is kept in {stage}.
branchChanged: The branch was changed by another operation
branchMoved: The branch or commit changed during the build, so the update was cancelled
remoteChanged: The latest remote commit changed. Check for updates again.
distTracked: web/dist contains files tracked by Git. Update this install by hand.
upToDate: Already on the latest commit of the tracked branch
diverged: The current branch has local-only commits or has diverged from the remote. Resolve that by hand before updating.
dirtyTree: The working tree has uncommitted changes or untracked files. Commit or move them before updating.
noUpstream: The current branch has no remote tracking branch. Set an upstream and try again.
detachedHead: You're on a detached HEAD. Switch to a local branch that tracks a remote branch first.
notRepoRoot: The program folder isn't the root of a Git repository, so it can't update automatically
gitFailed: git {value} failed. Check the repository, the tracked branch, and the network connection.
noFastForward: Git can't fast-forward; local files might be overwritten. Check the repository by hand.
gitLatestOnly: Git installs can only update to the latest commit of the tracked branch. Check for updates again.
releaseMissing: That version wasn't found. Refresh the version list.
rateLimited: The GitHub API rate limit is used up. Try again in {when}.
githubOffline: Can't reach GitHub. Check your network or proxy settings.
noGit: git isn't installed, so a source install can't be updated
notGit: This folder isn't a Git repository. Install with git clone or the one-click install script.
unsupportedLaunch: Automatic updates aren't supported in this launch mode. Start ShiritaiBot with shiritaibot run.
